from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancingCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """One company's net cash from financing activities for a reporting period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the filing")
    financing_cash_flow: float | None = Field(description="Net cash amount from financing activities; negative for outflows")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the amount: 'millions', 'thousands', or 'dollars'")
    period_months: int | None = Field(description="How many months this period covers (typically 3)")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date, format YYYY-MM")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short excerpt from the document with the financing activities line")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financing_cash_flows: list[FinancingCashFlow]
